title: First Googlebook laptops arrive with MediaTek Dimensity CX C10 Max chip to compete against MacBook and Windows
summary: MediaTek unveils its 8-core CPU and 11-core GPU SoC for AI laptops, debuting in Googlebook devices with Android integration starting at $899.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna: cut costs in half but barely improve performance
summary: OpenAI's new models slash prices dramatically though capability advances are marginal compared to previous versions.

title: Anthropic unveils Claude Opus 5.5 with lower prices and performance on par with Fable 5.1
summary: The new Opus version matches competitor Fable in benchmarks, reduces costs, and promises less 'Claudish' writing.

title: Meta's Muse agent accesses private iMessages and Amazon blocks it, sparking privacy debate
summary: Muse reads personal messages without consent, Amazon bans the bot, and researchers find a hidden configuration that could turn it into a backdoor.

title: ShinyHunters group claims to have hacked FBI and stolen agent and applicant data
summary: Hackers publish screenshots of FBI databases; the bureau investigates massive leak of sensitive information.

title: Qualcomm announces Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Gen 6: first 2nm chips to exceed 5 GHz
summary: The new lineup breaks the 5 GHz barrier and debuts 2nm process, focused on agentic AI and premium mobile experiences.

title: AMD adds GDDR7 support to Linux driver anticipating upcoming Radeon RX 11000 with RDNA 5
summary: The kernel patch paves the way for GDDR7 memory in next-gen graphics cards, possibly reserved for high-end.

title: SpaceX launches Grok 4.7 and places it in top 4 most advanced AIs, surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol
summary: xAI's new model excels in coding tasks and positions itself as a cost-effective high-performance alternative.

title: ASML admits it has no sales in Europe despite being the continent's largest tech company
summary: The extreme lithography manufacturer depends entirely on Asian and US customers, exposing the fragility of European chip sovereignty.

title: WordPress patches critical flaw allowing remote code execution on vulnerable servers
summary: An unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability and another in comments allow attackers to take control of the site.

title: Micron halts production of 2GB GDDR7 chips used in GeForce RTX 50
summary: The end of this memory module could affect supply of Nvidia's mid-to-high-range graphics cards.

title: Apple introduces persistent ads in iOS and users criticize intrusion into system experience
summary: The company places permanent advertising in settings and notifications, generating backlash for breaking the promise of an ad-free environment.

title: Microsoft closes Ninja Theory and transfers Halo development to Activision-Blizzard in restructuring
summary: The studio behind Hellblade closes and Xbox's flagship franchise passes to the Call of Duty publisher.
